review_candidates.title: Infrastructure Security Engineer, EGYPT
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Manage risk and incidents: Maintain our risk register, lead incident response when needed, and conduct post-mortems that drive lasting improvements. Ownership — "Act as an Owner": We take responsibility for outcomes end-to-end. Contractors are not employees of nsave and are responsible for their own taxes, insurance, and statutory obligations.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Who You Are Security engineer, not just an auditor: You can write policy and pass an audit, but you're equally comfortable getting hands-on in the infrastructure, identifying gaps, and fixing them. Must Have AWS Organizations design: Hands-on experience designing and building an AWS Organization from the ground up — multi-account structure, Organisational Units, Service Control Policies, and least-privilege IAM across every account. Infrastructure as code: Strong hands-on Terraform experience — you define infrastructure and security controls as code, and build guardrails into CI/CD so the secure path is the default one.
